protocol.status: post-hoc held-out comparison; not a fresh final test
protocol.model: frozen DistilBERT, 8 soft tokens, two correctness heads
protocol.data_loss: inverse-expected-query-cost weighted BCE over Nano/Mini correctness
protocol.prior_belief: Mini has higher base correctness than Nano

prior_methods.bias_map: Gaussian MAP on correctness-head intercept log-odds
prior_methods.mean_accuracy_kl: KL from declared correctness base rates to batch-mean predictions
prior_methods.mean_dominance: softplus penalty if mean Mini log-odds do not exceed Nano
prior_methods.pointwise_dominance: softplus penalty for each input whose Mini log-odds do not exceed Nano
